parties: Greaves Cotton Limited; Excel Controlinkage Private Limited
headline: Greaves Cotton acquires remaining stake in Excel Controlinkage to make it wholly owned subsidiary
sum: Greaves Cotton Limited has completed its acquisition of the remaining stake in Excel Controlinkage Private Limited, elevating the entity to wholly owned subsidiary status following a further acquisition announced to the NSE.
implication: The step-up acquisition of a material subsidiary to 100% ownership triggers mandatory valuation, board-level governance review and potential minority shareholder squeeze-out or buyback mechanics under the Companies Act and Listing Rules-standard precedent for creeping acquisitions of unlisted subsidiaries.
detail: Greaves Cotton Limited, an automotive engineering and manufacturing company, informed the NSE of a further acquisition in Excel Controlinkage Private Limited, a material subsidiary. The transaction results in Excel becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Greaves Cotton. The specific acquisition price, shareholding structure prior to the acquisition, and timing of the transaction completion are not disclosed in the NSE intimation.
